question_text: What comes next: A, C, E, G, ___?

hint_ladder.title: Hanapin ang Pattern ng Skip
hint_ladder.text: Count missing letters between terms: A to C (skip B), C to E (skip D), E to G (skip F). Pare-pareho: isang skip lagi.

hint_ladder.title: Ang Simpleng Panuntunan
hint_ladder.text: Rule: every step, skip one letter. So from G, skip H, diretso sa I. Easy, diba?

hint_ladder.title: Apply Dito sa Question
hint_ladder.text: After G, H ang binabaliwala (skip), so ang susunod na term ay I. Option B yan.

hint_ladder.title: Reminder: Every Other Letter
hint_ladder.text: Sequence: A, C, E, G, I — pili lang ng bawat ikalawang letra mula sa A. Others ay mali kasi nasa skip o sobra ang skip.

A.text: You might have chosen H because it's the immediate next letter, but the pattern skips one, so H is the gap, not the term.

B.text: Correct. The pattern is every other letter: A to C (skip B) to E (skip D) to G (skip F) to I (skip H).

C.text: You might have chosen J because you thought skip two, but the pattern only skips one consistently.

D.text: You might have chosen K because you skipped too many; pattern only skips one letter each step.

next_time_rule: For letter sequences, find the constant skip. If each step skips one letter (like A to C), pattern is +2 alphabet positions—'every other letter.'
deconstruct_text:
Minsan sa barangay, pag may meeting at kailangan ng social distancing, ang upuan na naka-occupy ay may isang bakante sa gitna. Parang letters: A (occupied), skip B, C (occupied), skip D, E (occupied), skip F, G (occupied). Ganyan ang sequence.

Sa numbers, A=1, C=3, E=5, G=7. Pattern: +2 each time. 7+2=9 — ang letter I. Mental Trick: Isipin mong ang bawat letter ay upuan — occupied, skip, occupied. Kaya pagdating mo sa G (occupied), skip H (bakante), at I na ang kasunod. Tandaan, 'every other letter' pattern.
